run_boot_dqn_agent: run a bootstrapped DQN agent on a bsuite environment with CSV logging
run_single_experiment: run a single bsuite experiment by passing a bsuite_id to the run function
run_sweep: run a multiprocess sweep over multiple bsuite experiments using pool.map_mpi
create_q_network: create a Q-network with randomized prior function using Haiku MLPs and JAX
build_bootstrapped_dqn: build a BootstrappedDQN agent with an ensemble of networks and Adam optimizer
